MEDIC.gloss: any of several Old World herbs of the genus Medicago having small flowers and…
MEDIC.definition: Any of several Old World herbs of the genus Medicago having small flowers and trifoliate compound leaves.

COME.gloss: move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
COME.definition: Move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody.
COME.example: He came singing down the road.

CODE.gloss: a set of rules or principles or laws
CODE.definition: A set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones).

MODE.gloss: how something is done or how it happens
MODE.definition: How something is done or how it happens.

DEMO.gloss: a visual presentation showing how something works
DEMO.definition: A visual presentation showing how something works.
DEMO.example: The lecture was accompanied by dramatic demonstrations.

DOME.gloss: a concave shape whose distinguishing characteristic is that the concavity faces downward
DOME.definition: A concave shape whose distinguishing characteristic is that the concavity faces downward.

DIE.gloss: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to…
DIE.definition: Pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life.

ICE.gloss: water frozen in the solid state
ICE.definition: Water frozen in the solid state.
ICE.example: Americans like ice in their drinks.

DOC.example: I felt so bad I went to see my doctor.

DEC.gloss: the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator
DEC.definition: (astronomy) the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator; expressed in degrees; used with right ascension to specify positions on the celestial sphere.

MOD.gloss: a British teenager or young adult in the 1960s
MOD.definition: A British teenager or young adult in the 1960s; noted for their clothes consciousness and opposition to the rockers.

COD.gloss: the vessel that contains the seeds of a plant
COD.definition: The vessel that contains the seeds of a plant (not the seeds themselves).

DOE.gloss: mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'
DOE.definition: Mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'.

DICE.gloss: a small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces
DICE.definition: A small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces; used in gambling to generate random numbers.

DIME.gloss: a United States coin worth one tenth of a dollar
DIME.definition: A United States coin worth one tenth of a dollar.

DECO.gloss: a style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s
DECO.definition: A style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s; marked by stylized forms and geometric designs adapted to mass production.
